While no wizard showed up (yet), what did happen was close enough: my skin literally drank this elixir up like it had been parched in the desert for years. One drop of this serum and BAM—I looked like I had been reborn as some ethereal, glowing goddess. My skin was instantly plumper, smoother, and, dare I say it—radiating light, like I had somehow been kissed by the skincare gods. Let's talk texture: It's lightweight, silky, and glides on like a dream. None of that sticky, heavy nonsense that makes you feel like your face just did hot yoga. This serum is more like the skincare equivalent of a fine silk robe—luxurious, but without even trying. And the glow. Oh, the glow! It's like someone installed a soft-focus filter on my face. My skin looks lit from within, as if I've been sipping celestial water and meditating under the stars. Fine lines? I don't know her anymore. Dry patches? Never met them. My face is smoother than a freshly polished crystal, which feels appropriate, given the serum's name. Plus, can we talk about the bottle for a second? It looks like it was plucked straight out of a royal vanity—just sitting on my bathroom shelf makes

•I received this product complimentary from Charlotte Tilbury in exchange for my honest review! The beautiful packaging captivated me most! The texture is very pleasing to the skin. It overall made my skin more hydrated, firm, and even gave it a nice lift!

Now this is definitely worth the splurge! It's one of those serums that feels milky and luxurious. The ingredients are really what make this serum unique. It has a mix of Vitamin C, niacinamide, and polyglutamic acid, each targeting different skin concerns. Vitamin C and niacinamide together bring in brightness and even out skin tone. Polyglutamic acid, which is like an ultra hydrating hyaluronic acid, keeps moisture locked in for a dewy look. Also, the presence of glutathione acts as an antioxidant, neutralizing free radicals and helping to maintain a youthful glow. It also contains botanical extracts, like Replexium, a peptide blend that claims to help with firmness and reduce wrinkles, which helps skin look and feel a bit more plump over time. If you're sensitive to fragrance, just a heads up that this serum does contain parfum, so it might not be ideal for extremely sensitive skin. I have sensitive/acne prone skin and I haven't noticed any breakouts or irritation myself. The texture is lightweight and a little goes a long way. Not only does it layer well under makeup, but it actually works really well as a makeup primer too. Overall, I'd say it's worth its price tag and if you're willing to splurge on a serum, this should be this one. It combines multiple skincare benefits in one step, and it's truly unlike any other serum I've tried. I would confidently recommend it.
